summary: Innate Pharma SA filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its participation in the D. Boral Capital Global Conference on May 7, 2026, in New York. The company's executive team will engage in one-on-one investor meetings. This is a routine investor-relations activity with no transaction, stake change, price terms, or special situation. The filing contains standard corporate information and forward-looking disclaimers. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. Since this is merely a conference participation notice, it does not meet the criteria for a special-situation category.
